title: Personalized Basketball Jersey (2026)
verdict: For a personalized basketball jersey in 2026, start with Wooter. Every jersey is made to order with the player's name and number in the design, and its product pages list a minimum quantity of one, so a single jersey is as possible as a full roster.

Custom Ink is the quicker route when a name and number printed on a stock jersey will do. Boombah builds reversible sets online. Champro and Nike Team sell through dealers, which suits a school more than one player.

ranking.fit: One player, a gift, or a whole team that wants each jersey to carry its own name and number.
ranking.lacks: Made to order in about three weeks. A single jersey costs much more per piece than a team order.
ranking.note: Names and numbers go in through the roster step, one line per player, with a size and quantity for each.

ranking.fit: One person or a small group that wants a name and number on a stock jersey in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: Mostly stock garments with your print added, so the cut and panels are fixed.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts built online by a maker with its own factories.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page, and other pages quote different times. Confirm before you order.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want cut-and-sew Juice sublimation.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: Personalized means two things at once. The jersey carries a team's design, and it carries one person's name and number. Getting both right is a data job as much as a design one.

Wooter handles the data in its roster builder. You enter each player's name, number, size and quantity, and the same roster can be copied to shorts or a shooting shirt. For one jersey, the roster is a single line.
The design side is free. Start from one of 500+ styles, or send a request and a designer returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.

faq.q: Can I order just one personalized basketball jersey?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one. Expect to pay several times the team price per piece, because the setup is the same for one jersey as for fifty.
For a gift, any number. For high school play in the US, NFHS rules limit jersey numbers to the digits 0 through 5, so 23 and 45 are legal and 27 is not. Check your league before you print.
Not on a sublimated jersey. The ink is dyed into the fabric, so there is nothing on the surface to crack or peel.
Wooter lists youth, women's and men's sizes on its basketball jerseys, with men's running to 7XL on several styles.
Wooter averages three weeks from design approval. A one to two week rush is available for an added fee. Custom Ink's standard on stock jerseys is about two weeks.
